critical_nonadditive_oracle_finding.source_rule: Wizards 2026 Comprehensive Rules 120.3a and 120.4b/c: damage dealt and resulting player life loss are distinct events/values.
findings: Ob Nixilis triggers on exactly ONE life lost by one-or-more opponents in an event. A Kessig single simultaneous one-to-each-opponent ping creates one Ob trigger, not three.

Solphim replaces one source damage with TWO damage before that event is dealt; such Kessig or Spear events cause no Ghyrson exactly-one-damage trigger and no Ob exactly-one-life-loss trigger absent other replacement/context.

Bloodletter instead replaces resulting opponent LIFE LOSS, not the underlying amount of DAMAGE dealt. An original one-damage Kessig event still triggers Ghyrson, but its opponent life loss becomes two, suppressing Ob. Ghyrson's later two-damage event can result in four life loss with Bloodletter.
Harmonic doubles Kessig/Thermo/Vivi/Storm-Kiln Shaman/Wizard triggered abilities, not Abaddon's static cascade grant, not the self damage of non-Shaman Spear Spewer, and not Kederekt (Horror).

With four players and ready Kessig+Harmonic+Ghyrson+Ob but NO doublers, one noncreature cast makes two separate Kessig one-to-each damage events and six Ghyrson followup two-damage events: three opponents lose 18 aggregate life, Ob triggers TWICE, and the initiating hand-cast spell never retroactively gains Abaddon cascade.

With both Solphim and Bloodletter absent, Kederekt while controlling a red permanent and a Wheel/Windfall opponent seven-draw event makes one damage event per actual opponent card draw, creating 21 potential Ob triggers across three opponents; triggers resolve after the wheel, not before its original Abaddon cascade check.

Spear Spewer's original one-to-EACH-player event plus Ghyrson followups causes its controller to lose 3 life too (one Spear damage plus 2 Ghyrson damage), while opponents lose 3 each. Spear must be able to activate {T}; no automatic summoning-sick immediate ping.

opportunity_costs.cost: Unique Warhammer opponent-card theft with owner's life loss on cast, meaningful nonhand reward; replacing with Ob is not free and may erase flavor.
One generic discount on blue and red spells, including UBR Abaddon and many spells, reducing commander tax and early storm mana friction.
Doubles ALL opponents' life loss on own turn including no-damage life-loss; B B B pip tension but huge threshold and finisher value.
Doubles all noncombat controlled-source damage to opponents and their permanents, instant independent threshold amplification and indestructibility access.
Damage-free basic red/fetch resilience versus Mount Doom which costs one life per colored tap and 3 mana plus tap for X3 opponent loss.
Reliable commander-present start-of-combat three-to-each life loss X9, no extra mana after initial 3 MV deployment; later second main cascades.
One-R blue stack or blue permanent counter/answer and flexibility; aggressive seven-swap loses a critical shield against control.

conditional_judgments.reason: Four sourced live Shaman/Wizard engines and one mana-free cascade synergy; requires them alive, losing Nightscape's broad discount.
On-theme Warhammer ping multiplier with ward; anti-synergy with Solphim damage-doubling prevents exactly-one trigger.
Reliable exiled playable-card draw with individual exact-one ping triggers; Bloodletter and Solphim suppress that trigger, forcing expensive package tradeoffs.
B one-mana red-permanent-powered wheel engine enabling Ob and a post-wheel X; highly vulnerable 1-toughness body, sometimes unenabled.
Tapped-mana BR fixer plus repeatable own-turn X3 at {1}{B}{R} plus tap, but costs life and loses fetchable Mountain basic.
Cheap repeatable X3 group loss but summoning sickness and Ghyrson X3 controller life loss make self-race real.
Four mana 6-to-each or flexible artifact removal, credible when losing stack protection but cannot replace Call Forth printed double cascade.
Retain incumbent: MV8 printed double cascade, MV9 Blasphemous Act can cascade into it; Blood MV11 cannot be hit by current cascade sources.
Do not cut by count; protect with it in protected five option, adversarial removal only in seven option.

finite_scenarios.summary: Dual Kessig triggers yield total X18 with Ghyrson, two Ob triggers, after starting spell cast; requires four bodies including Abaddon if cascading.
Approved Bloodletter/Solphim give independently useful amplification when redrawn; proposed exact-one package needs rebuild, Ghyrson/Ob alone can be blank.
Seven-swap option cannot Pyroblast a blue counter/permanent; all remaining answers require their actual own costs, cards, targets and stack timing.
Deleting Nightscape's generic discount raises actual pay by {1} whenever it would have applied, including initial UBR and commander-tax recasts.
